name: Cell 0
summary: Cell 0 is a psychological first-person horror and anomaly-hunting experience inspired by liminal space nightmares. You wake up trapped inside a cold, endless containment facility where every corridor feels familiar, yet something terrifying is shifting with every step you take. Survival requires razor-sharp observation and nerves of steel as you inspect each corridor for anomalies and descend through ten escalating containment sectors to reach Cell 0 and break the loop.
